summary: Post-market with the composite at 44.17 and a single-day trend of 0.08, the regime still goldilocks, the day's story is a discount-rate shock the model has not yet absorbed: the press reports the 10-year Treasury yield spiking to a 19-year high above 5.1 and the 5-year breaking above 5 for the first time since 2007, with stocks falling and the Nasdaq retreating from its record, while the layer's rate block still carries a fresh 2026-09-21 observation with the 10-year easing from 5.01 to 4.96 and the real rate from 2.68 to 2.62, at the 99.6th and 99.84th percentiles. The tape took the hit the score did not: only 7 of the 22 sector and theme rows advanced, with Semis Leaders at -1.8554, Robotics at -2.1939 and Internet Platforms at -1.8797, while Industrial Automation at 1.605 and Enterprise Software at 1.3489 held. Semiconductors fell with Nvidia at -1.5479, Micron at -2.163 and Broadcom at -2.1742, so today's lift came from rotation rather than breadth. Credit and volatility still refuse to confirm stress, high-yield OAS at 2.68 and VIX at 14.21, while the A-share panel closed mixed, 4 of the 11 tracked names higher. Policy is the binding watch, the FedWatch implied rate at 4.19 carrying a hike action against an effective rate of 3.88.

top_risk_drivers.claim: Macro is the heaviest block at 69.22 and it supplies the two largest model contributions after the cross-asset term: the 10-year real rate at 2.62 adds 4.992 points and the 10-year yield at 4.96 adds 4.96, sitting at the 99.84th and 99.6th percentiles. Even after easing from 2.68 and 5.01, the discount-rate constraint is barely off its cycle extreme, so the move is relief rather than repair.

Today's discount-rate shock is not yet in the model. The press reports the 10-year yield rocketing to a 19-year high above 5.1 and the 5-year above 5 for the first time since 2007, with stocks falling and the Nasdaq retreating from its record, yet the layer's rate block is still a 2026-09-21 observation and shows neither move. The equity impact did land in the layer: Semis Leaders at -1.8554 with Nvidia at -1.5479, Micron at -2.163 and Broadcom at -2.1742.

The reverse repo facility is the largest non-rate contribution at 3.7176 points and it is nearly exhausted: 0.461, a 3.53 percentile reading scoring 92.94 on risk, and Wednesday's operation is confirmed in the press flow. Reserves rose from 2991310 to 3013794 and the Fed balance sheet from 6740619 to 6746548, so the drain is small in size but it is being run off an almost empty cushion.

Cross-asset confirmation is the largest weighted contribution at 7.5 points, with the composite signal at 0.625 and the dollar index at 119.5133. The block scores 50.0, its signal is only partly confirming, and it is the one block that did not improve as the rate story turned.

Equity structure scores 48.21 and is rising, and its internals are inverted: the new-lows ratio at 0.0581 now exceeds the new-highs ratio at 0.0323, which contributes 2.9057 points, and only 0.6065 of the universe sits above its 200-day average, with Semis Relative at -10.8429 and Small Cap Relative at -9.5413. A few percent of the universe making new highs is doing real work inside a 44.17 composite.

supporting_signals.claim: Credit and volatility still refuse to confirm stress: high-yield OAS at 2.68 in the 8.65th percentile and investment-grade at 0.77 in the 13.63rd, with VIX easing from 14.87 to 14.21 and realized volatility at 10.8652. The liquidity and credit block scores 33.24 and the volatility block 14.58, the two least-stressed blocks in a 44.17 composite.

Inflation expectations are anchored while nominal yields lurch: the 10-year breakeven slipped from 2.34 to 2.33 and the 5-year forward from 2.35 to 2.34, and core CPI eased from 2.46652 to 2.44616 even as headline CPI rose from 3.30386 to 3.35302. The rate move is a real-rate and term-premium story rather than an inflation-expectations shock.

The session's gains came from rotation rather than broad participation: Industrial Automation at 1.605, Enterprise Software at 1.3489, Cybersecurity at 0.7566 and AI Software at 0.2526 all advanced while the semiconductor complex fell, and Auto at 0.2375 with Tesla at 0.2375 held and Data Centers at 0.0214. Defensive software and industrials absorbing a rate shock is a rotation signature, not a liquidation one.

The trend block still scores a benign 43.45: the price sits 7.003 above its 200-day average, the 52-week drawdown is only -1.2881 and 3-month momentum is 4.7215. Nothing in the medium-term structure has broken yet, which is why the composite moved only 0.08.

The labor data behind the policy path is firm rather than weak: non-farm payrolls at 162.0 against a prior 21.0, initial claims easing from 206000 to 196000, continuing claims from 1769000 to 1730000 and the participation rate from 61.4 to 61.6. That is the macro backdrop against which the press build-up to a hike is being priced.

contradicting_signals.claim: The composite's 0.08 move understates the day: the macro block reads a rate series whose latest observation predates today's spike, so the 69.22 macro score is measuring a 4.96 yield while the press reports a 19-year high. The score's calm is partly a vintage artefact rather than a judgement that the move does not matter.

Crypto sold off with the rate move rather than hedging it: bitcoin fell to 84440 with a -2.37496 daily change, ether to 2673.47 and Solana to 114.56, and bitcoin dominance sits at 0.588424. The asset class that behaved as the cleanest risk proxy this quarter is now moving with the discount rate.

The A-share panel did not confirm the day's US rotation: 7 of the 11 tracked names closed lower, with 603986.sh at -0.8406, 301308.sz at -0.6518 and 300475.sz at -1.1976, and only 4 closed higher. Asian markets closed hours before the US session began, so this is separate tracks rather than transmission.

Policy is priced tighter than it is and the decision lands inside the window: the FedWatch implied rate is 4.19 with a hike action while the effective fed funds rate is 3.88, and the FOMC meets on 2026-09-28. The press attributes today's yield spike to fresh services and manufacturing data stoking fears of further hikes.

The calm in credit is a level statement, not a direction one: high-yield OAS widened from 2.66 to 2.68, the reverse repo facility sits in the 3.53 percentile with a risk score of 92.94, and the 33.24 score of the liquidity block rests on a facility that is nearly empty. There is little left to absorb a funding surprise.

what_changed_today: The composite moved 0.08 to 44.17 with the risk level at caution and the regime at goldilocks unchanged, and macro at 69.22 stayed the heaviest block.
Rates rolled to a fresh 2026-09-21 observation and the move was lower: the 10-year yield from 5.01 to 4.96, the real rate from 2.68 to 2.62 and the 2-year unchanged at 4.76.
The reverse repo facility rose from 0.453 to 0.461 on a fresh 2026-09-23 observation while reserves climbed from 2991310 to 3013794 and the Fed balance sheet from 6740619 to 6746548.
The tape rotated out of semiconductors: Semis Leaders at -1.8554 with Nvidia at -1.5479, Micron at -2.163 and Broadcom at -2.1742, while only 7 of the 22 sector and theme rows advanced.
Credit widened a notch and volatility fell: high-yield OAS from 2.66 to 2.68 with investment-grade unchanged at 0.77, and VIX from 14.87 to 14.21.
Crypto turned down: bitcoin at 84440, ether at 2673.47 and Solana at 114.56, all lower on the day.

The press agenda shifted to energy policy and AI governance: a reported 90-day diesel export ban was floated and then denied, and AI-safety limits were argued at the UN while Anthropic said it would slow development.
watch_next: Whether the reported yield spike reaches the model: the next observation of the 10-year at 4.96 and the real rate at 2.62 would need to print higher before the macro block at 69.22 reflects today, and 4.96 is the near-term pivot.
The FOMC on 2026-09-28 and the implied path around it, with FedWatch at 4.19 carrying a hike action against an effective rate of 3.88.
Whether the reverse repo facility at 0.461 keeps draining toward zero and whether reserves at 3013794 follow. That is where funding stress would first appear.
Whether the rotation into Industrial Automation at 1.605 and Enterprise Software at 1.3489 persists, or the semiconductor decline at -1.8554 broadens to the rest of the complex.
Costco earnings on 2026-09-24, then the 2026-09-30 Personal Income and Outlays and GDP releases and the 2026-10-02 Employment Situation, with payrolls at 162.0 against a prior 21.0.
Whether the A-share panel's 7 of 11 lower close reverses, and whether crypto's slide deepens, with Solana at 114.56 and ether at 2673.47.

bull_case.title: A rate spike that fades into rotation
points: The reported yield spike proves to be a one-session event and the series confirms the direction already in the layer: the 10-year from 5.01 to 4.96 and the real rate from 2.68 to 2.62, with breakevens anchored at 2.33 and 2.34, so the macro block at 69.22 stops dominating the composite.

Credit and volatility keep validating the benign case, with high-yield OAS at 2.68, investment-grade at 0.77 and VIX at 14.21, so the rotation into Enterprise Software at 1.3489 and Industrial Automation at 1.605 broadens back into the semiconductor complex.

The liquidity cushion refills rather than drains, with the reverse repo facility rebounding above 0.461 while reserves at 3013794 hold, removing the one channel that could turn a rate story into a funding story.

base_case.title: A pinned composite over a stale rate read
points: The composite stays pinned near 44.17 with a single-day trend of 0.08, as macro at 69.22 and equity structure at 48.21 offset liquidity and credit at 33.24 and volatility at 14.58, leaving the risk level and the regime unchanged.

The 10-year at 4.96 in the 99.6th percentile and the real rate at 2.62 in the 99.84th cap multiple expansion, so breadth stays narrow with 0.6065 above the 200-day average and 0.0323 making new highs against 0.0581 making new lows.

The model keeps reporting a calm that the press flow contradicts, so the 44.17 composite lags the tape until the next rate vintage lands, and the divergence between the score and the session persists.

bear_case.title: A hawkish delivery into an empty cushion
points: The reported spike is confirmed and extended: the next 10-year print comes in above 4.96 and the real rate above 2.62, pushing both past their 99.6th and 99.84th percentiles and re-accelerating the macro block at 69.22.
The cushion is already gone, since the reverse repo facility at 0.461 in the 3.53 percentile scoring 92.94 leaves reserves at 3013794 as the only buffer, and the FOMC on 2026-09-28 delivers into it.

The decline broadens back out of software and industrials: Semis Relative at -10.8429 and Small Cap Relative at -9.5413 describe a market where only 0.0323 makes new highs, so 7 advancing rows out of 22 was already a rotation running out of buyers.
